content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've built a project to read a Drager Regard 3900 gas detection system using [product_name] via Modbus. I want to visualize the data remotely using [product_name] web editor. While I can see my data on the controller (verified using the I/O-status), it doesn't update on the web interface. Could someone help me figure out what's missing? I've attached both my controller program and web editor project. Thank you for any assistance. Best regards, [user_name]

I transferred your controller program to my [product_name] (software version [version_no]) and the web editor project as well. Since I don’t have your Modbus device, I removed the Modbus connection to simulate values. The simulated results (AM1 to AM4) are visible in the extended web server without any issues.

That's odd. I'm using software version [version_no], which shouldn't make a difference, right? Still, it's not working on my end. My base module is a [article_no] ([article_no] version). I've attached the I/O-status log showing a value for AM2, but the web server still displays nothing (see screenshot). Does anyone know what could be wrong? Any support would be appreciated. Regards, [user_name]

Let’s look at your calculation for AM1. The value from B002 (AM5) is multiplied by B003 (AM6), then divided by 1000. The log shows AM5 = 0, AM6 = 50. So 0 * 50 / 1000 = 0 and AM1 is 0. For AM2, you have B018 (AM7) times B019 (AM8), divided by 1000. Log says AM5 = 548, AM6 = 10. So 548 * 10 / 1000 = 5.48, rounded down to 5 by the controller — AM2 shows 5. For AM3, B034 (AM9) multiplied by B035 (AM10) and divided by 1000 gives 0 as AM5 = 0, AM6 = 100. For AM4, B050 (AM11) times B051 (AM12) and divided by 1000 results in 0 with AM5 = 0, AM6 = 1000.
That still doesn't clarify why AM2 is not updating on the extended web server. Does anyone have further ideas? I'm really stuck. Thank you in advance.
I can't say for sure. For me, it works when I simulate the VM data. Which [product_name] web editor version are you using? And which browser?
I created the original web server using [product_name] web editor v1.1. After upgrading to v1.2 and redeploying the project, everything works as expected. Thanks for the help.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered issues with real-time Modbus device data not updating on the [product_name] web editor interface, even though the values appeared on the controller. Upgrading the web editor software resolved the problem, indicating it was a software version compatibility or bug issue, not a configuration or hardware problem. Users also reviewed the logic and calculations to rule out programming errors.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] web editor interface to automatically and reliably display updates from the controller in real time for remote sensor monitoring.
